text:
emil: Quick flag — new ptq-lite canary shows a concentrated increase in funcall JSON parse failures for streaming multi-turn sessions. fp16 ~0.6%, ptq-lite int8 ~7.9%.

canary-bot: Canary alert: funcall_parse_fail_rate=7.9% (5m) for ptq-lite-canary. dashboard: https://canary.internal/ptq-lite/canary

zara: Can someone paste one minimal raw concatenated stream? A single example helps determine cutoff vs malformed generation.

emil: sample (joined stream chunks): `{"action":"claim","args":{"ticket":88,"state":"queued"}

{"action":"notify","args":{"peer":"u22","msg":"assigned"}}` — note missing close after first object.

pat: This looks like a token boundary cutoff. ptq-lite uses int8 PTQ + sequence packing + streaming. Did quant change merging of special tokens or EOS?

emil: Non-stream mirror runs show much lower failures (1.9%), so streaming + kvcache reuse seems to amplify.

zara: Immediate short-term mitigation: add a conservative parser repair behind a flag. Strategy: try strict parse -> if fail, attempt schema-aware close (prefer closing arrays/objects according to expected funcall schema) -> if still fail, try last-brace cut. Emit a repair_confidence and action_checksum delta.

pat: Love the schema-aware idea. Blind cuts cause silent semantic changes. Also add metric repaired_semantic_mismatch_count. If action_checksum changes, mark as repaired_but_semantic_delta and do NOT auto-execute sensitive actions.

emil: Also collect last 8 token ids for every failed session (sample 1% to S3 secure) so we can run a token-boundary bisect. We need to compare fp16 vs ptq-lite token ids around punctuation and whitespace.

benchbot: Quick snapshot (n=400 multi-turn streaming sessions): fp16 parse_fail=0.6%, ptq-lite parse_fail=7.9%, repaired_schema_anchor=2.3%, repaired_cut=1.1%, unrepaired=4.5%, repaired_changed_action=0.5%.

zara: Plan: run a 3x2 grid: streaming {on,off,partial} x kvcache {reuse,no-reuse} with batch sizes {1,4}. "partial" streaming = artificially split streams to stress boundaries. For each failing session sample last-8 token ids.

emil: Implementation notes:
- @pat: implement parser-rescue lib with mode flags {off,cut_only,schema_anchor_first}. Emit telemetry events: funcall.parse.attempt with tags {model,quant,streaming,kvcache,batch,repair_strategy,repair_confidence,action_checksum_delta}.
- @zara: start the grid and token-id dumps, upload to secure bucket (no user text).
- @benchbot: track repaired_semantic_mismatch_count and pause canary if unrepaired>5% or repaired_changed_action>1%.

pat: I'll push a small python lib behind the feature flag. Pseudo:```python
def parse_or_repair(raw):
    try:
        return json.loads(raw), None
    except ValueError:
        # schema-anchor attempt (schematic)
        anchor = try_schema_anchor_close(raw)
        if anchor.success:
            return anchor.obj, {'strategy':'schema_anchor','confidence':anchor.score}
        # fallback: cut at last '}'
        idx = raw.rfind('}')
        if idx!=-1:
            return json.loads(raw[:idx+1]), {'strategy':'cut','confidence':0.4}
        raise
```

zara: For schema_anchor, we'll ship a tiny funcall schema v1: top-level object with fields {action:string, args:object} and optional array wrapper. Use that to decide which bracket to close.

emil: For token bisect: we'll align token ids for punctuation tokens [ '{', '}', '[', ']', ',', ':' ] and compute where id differs between fp16 and int8. If shifts correlate with failures we consider blocking the ptq-lite rollout.

benchbot: Starting grid now (first wave 500 sessions). Will post aggregated metrics every 15m.

zara: Safety rule: never auto-apply repairs for HIGH_RISK actions = ["delete_user","revoke_key","transfer_credits"]. If repair_confidence < 0.7 but action_checksum preserved, mark as repaired_low_confidence and surface warning to caller.

emil: If token bisect points to quant-induced tokenization drift around punctuation, short-term options: disable sequence packing for streaming ptq traffic or revert streaming portion of the canary to fp16. Long-term: adjust quant pipeline tokenizer merges.

pat: ETA for parser-rescue behind feature flag PR: 2 hours. Will include telemetry and repair_confidence calc.

zara: I'll share first token-id sample link when available. Keep replies short in this thread.

emil: tl;dr: ptq-lite streaming shows stitched/truncated JSONs. Short-term: schema-aware repairs + telemetry + token-id dumps. Medium-term: token-boundary bisect and quant pipeline fix or rollback.
